subject: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap
messages:
From: Avi Shah <avi@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput numbers looked promising. We're finalizing our accelerator package and have a couple of asks on credits and billing that deterministically affect our go/no-go. Quick summary: 

- Program offer: 200k free token credits over 6 months (as a startup partner).
- Our ask: allow a per-month smoothing/carry-forward so we can use more in months 1–2 for model tuning, then less later.
- Secondary ask: a one-time promotional top-up (30k tokens) if we hit the product milestone in month 3.

Two constraints on our side: procurement requires an explicit monthly cap for invoicing, and our legal team wants the promotional top-up to be tied to a milestone rather than open-ended. Can Redwood provide a simple carveout that: (a) allows carry-forward up to 50% of unused credit in month 1 into month 2, (b) sets a monthly invoicing cap of $1,500 for overages beyond the free credits, and (c) documents the 30k promotional top-up as milestone-driven in an SOW?

If this is something you can approve or route for quick sign-off, please let us know — we'd like to close the program commitment before Oct 10.

Thanks,
Avi Shah
Head of Platform, Nimbus Labs
avi@nimbuslabs.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Avi Shah <avi@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap

Hi Avi — great to hear and glad the numbers looked useful. Short answers up front: yes on a carry-forward, yes on a milestone-tied top-up in the SOW, and maybe on the $1,500 overage cap depending on the structure (I circled Ben for approval on that specific cap).

Proposed framework from Redwood:
- Total program credits: 200,000 tokens allocated as "program credits" over a 6-month window.
- Carry-forward: up to 50% of unused credits in a given month may be transferred to the following month, once, for the first two months only.
- Overage handling: we can offer a capped billing rate for overages (suggested $1,500/month) but need Ben's sign-off to finalize the cap and whether it applies to all accounts in the cohort or is a one-off.
- Milestone top-up: 30,000 tokens added as a conditional credit; we'll include the exact milestone language in the SOW and attach it to the enrollment paperwork.

I'll draft the SOW language and the short carveout clause for procurement. Ben — any concerns about grandfathering this cap for Nimbus specifically?

Next steps: I will attach a brief MAP (program map) and a draft SOW for your review by Monday. If you can confirm procurement prefers invoice-based caps or pre-paid thresholds, that would help.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Nimbus-Program-MAP-2027.pdf (program summary)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Avi Shah <avi@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap

Chloe / team —

I'm OK with the proposed carveout for Nimbus as a one-off within the accelerator cohort. Approve the following: 
- Carry-forward up to 50% for month 1->2 only.
- Conditional top-up 30k tokens, milestone to be defined in SOW.
- Set the overage invoicing cap at $1,500/month for this account only; finance will treat it as an exception to standard cohort policy.

Two notes:
1) We should include a clause that any sustained overage pattern (3 consecutive months) triggers a review and potential conversion to a paid commitment at market rates.
2) Have Legal weigh in on the milestone language in the SOW to avoid ambiguous triggers.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avi Shah <avi@nimbuslabs.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap

Avi — quick clarification from the billing side: When you say procurement needs a "monthly invoicing cap of $1,500 for overages," do you mean an invoice ceiling (i.e., we will never bill more than $1,500 in a single month) or an estimate for budget planning and the ability to exceed with approval? Our approved exception (per Ben) would be an invoice ceiling, but Finance will require a sign-off that any single invoice over $1,500 will be credited back and escalated for review. Is that acceptable to Nimbus?

If you confirm, I'll add the exact language to the SOW and the enrollment terms.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Avi Shah <avi@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Labs accelerator: credits packaging & billing cap

Avi — thanks for the quick replies and for the confirm on procurement. Per Marissa's question, Nimbus confirmed by phone that they want an invoice ceiling (we will not bill more than $1,500 in any given month; any amount above will be credited pending manual approval). They also approved the milestone definition: "30k token top-up issued upon completion of the first production model deployment (as defined by commit to prod and a smoke test passing for the primary inference endpoint)." Legal flagged two minor tweaks and we'll circulate a redline tomorrow.

Attached: SOW-nimbus-draft.docx (draft milestone language and the cap clause). Once you sign the enrollment form we will provision the program credits and enable carry-forward per the approved rules.

Proposed next steps:
- Monday: Legal redline and final SOW to Nimbus for signature (DocuSign link will be sent).
- Tuesday: Provision credits in the console and set monthly monitoring alerts.
- Ongoing: Marissa will be the billing contact for any cap adjustments.

If all sounds right, Avi, I'll send the DocuSign and enrollment form first thing Monday.

Best,
Chloe
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOW-nimbus-draft.docx
